title.narrative: Sichuan Chongqing Cooperation: Guang'an Demonstration Area Infrastructure Development Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to improve Linshui County and Qianfeng District infrastructure and investment support services.

The objective of the Sichuan Chongqing Cooperation: Guangan Demonstration Area Infrastructure Development Project for China is to improve Linshui County and Qianfeng District infrastructure and investment support services. There are four components to the project, the first component being technical assistance. Provision of technical assistance to: (a) Linshui County to conduct a cumulative strategic environmental and social impact assessment and improve the planning of capital investments and managing of built assets. The second component is the Linshui county town. This component includes: a green transport corridor between Linshui County's urban core and Linshui Economic and Technology Development Zone (ETDZ) and (ii) a linkage to the highway connecting Guangan City to Chongqing at the southeastern section of the Linshui ETDZ, consisting of selected roads with associated installations, including public transport and facilities, urban greenery and lighting. The third component is the Qianfeng District Town. This component includes: (a) development of a passenger and cargo route bypassing Qianfeng District Town's urban core, through the construction of a road with associated installations, greening and lighting; and (b) construction of a slow, green, transport corridor connecting Qianfeng District Town's urban core and Qianfeng District's southern industrial expansion area, consisting of, inter alia, riverside roads, parks, and green space areas along the Luxi River, as well as wastewater interceptors, storm water drainage and associated sewer pipelines, and lighting. Finally, the fourth component is the project management.

IRI #2&3-1 Volume (mass) of COD pollution load reduction achieved under the project

comment.narrative: <p>Target EXCEEDED.  This indicator measures the volume (mass) of Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) pollution load reduction through process modification to reduce a load of pollutants requiring treatment, and/or through the application of wastewater treatment techniques to reduce a load of contaminants prior to discharge. The baseline for this indicator is zero and reflects zero pollution reduction because the project had not yet started. The end result reflects the investment in sewerage networks and WWTPs in Linshui County Town (1,250.32) and Qianfeng District Town (650), reflecting a total of 1,900.32 tons/year reduction.  The end target was modified in the March 2020 and September 2021 restructurings, and the breakdown sub-indicators were added in the February 2022 restructuring.  <em>???????Source:  World Bank supervision reports</em><em>?</em></p>

title.narrative: IRI #2&3-4 Roads constructed, non-rural (Qianfeng and Linshui)

comment.narrative: <p>Target EXCEEDED AND SUBSTANTIALL ACHIEVED IN QIANFENG DISTRICT TOWN.  This include the urban road reconstruction whichwas added during the first restructuring to fully utilize the loan.  The result reflects: 16.09 km of non-rural roads in Linshui County Town (2.78 km Number 2 Road, 0.8 km Number 3 Road, 0.62 km Number 4 Road, 0.48 km Number 5 Road, 4.76 km Number 1 Road, plus and 6.65 km of re-constructed non-rural roads in Linshui ETDZ); and 7.49 km of non-rural roadsin Qianfeng District Town (3.17 km of the Industrial Avenue and 4.32 km of the Binghe South). The breakdown sub-indicators were added in the February 2022 restructuring.  <em>???????Source:  World Bank supervision reports</em></p>

<p>Target EXCEEDED AND SUBSTANTIALLY ACHIEVED IN QIANFENG DISTRICT TOWN.  In Linshui County Town, 27.91 km of sewers were constructed in the ETDZ: LS 1: 6.95 km; LS 2 - 5.4km; LS 3: 9.56km; LS 7 - 6km. In Qianfeng, 12.60 km of sewerswere constructed along the Luxi River: QF 1: 10.9km; QF 2: 1.7km.  The breakdown sub-indicators were added in the February 2022 restructuring.  <em>???????Source:  World Bank supervision reports</em></p>

title.narrative: IRI #1-1 Project-supported organizations publishing reports on Grievance Redress Mechanism and how issues were resolved (including resolution rates)

comment.narrative: <p>Target ACHIEVED.  GRMs were established at the initial stage of the project implementation at the levels of the municipality, counties/districts, and for procurement activities. The GRMs operated alongside citizen engagement and public consultations.  Complaints were recorded, reported, and addressed in a timely manner.  The grievances, concerns, and complaints from project-affected people and households were mostly on resettlement and land acquisition. Complaints were also received during road rehabilitation in the town centers of both towns, and special hotlines were set up to receive complaints and resolve the issues and/or mitigate the impacts. This was well recognized by the public. Issues recorded in the audit report were also addressed under the supervision of the Bank task team and to the satisfaction of the public.  <em>???????Source:  World Bank supervision reports, environmental and social external monitoring reports.  </em></p>

title.narrative: IRI #1-3 Preparation of capital investment and municipal asset management plans

comment.narrative: <p>Target ACHIEVED.  Plans for each town were prepared by a consultant and the final plans plus executive summary were received by the Bank task team in August 2022.  <em>???????Source:  World Bank supervision reports</em></p>

title.narrative: IRI #1-4 Preparation of value chain assessment (VCA), private sector demand survey (PSD), and investment promotion services (IPS)

comment.narrative: <p>Target ACHIEVED.  The VCA and PSD were completed in 2015, and an IPS was completed in 2020.  This activity provided guidance to two industrial zone management committees on how to integrate their local economies into the Sichuan-Chongqing (Cheng-Yu) Economic Zone, a strategic metropolitan cluster identified by the Chinese government.??????? <em>Source:  World Bank supervision reports</em></p>

comment.narrative: <p>Target ACHIEVED.  This TA was completed and a final report was submitted to the Bank in August 2022 by the Guang'an PMO.  <em>???????Source:  World Bank supervision reports</em></p>

title.narrative: IRI #2&3-3 Km of storm water drainage constructed

comment.narrative: <p>Target ACHIEVED AND SUBSTANTIALLY ACHIEVED IN QIANFENG DISTRICT TOWN.  In Linshui County Town, a total of 28.70 km were constructed: Contract LS 2: 9.80 km; LS 3: 12.20 km; and LS 7: 6.70 km.  In Qianfeng District Town, 9.30 km were constructed: Contract QF 2: 3.3 km and QF 4a: 6.00 km.  The indicator was introduced under the March 2020 restructuring??????? to better reflect project activities.  Breakdown sub-indicators were added in the February 2022 restructuring.  <em>???????Source:  World Bank supervision reports</em></p>

<p>Target SUBSTANTIALLY ACHIEVED.  The constructed as-built floor areas of 39,694.54 m2 includes: classroom building of 12,927.60 m2, a canteen of 4,129.08 m2, No.1 Dormitory of 4,015.91 m2, No.2 Dormitory of 5,331.08 m2, a car mechanic building of 4,427.40 m2, an electronic training building of 4,228.20 m2, and a garage of 4,635.7 m2.  The indicator related to the area of the new school facility was not fully met; however, construction was fully completed and delivered for use at project closing. ??????? The indicator was introduced under the March 2020 restructuring??????????????.  <em>???????Source:  World Bank supervision reports and LVS Annual Report</em></p>

comment.narrative: <p>Target ACHIEVED.  The result is based on 18,644 m3/d and 1,018 m3/d of wastewater collected and treated by Numbers 2 and 3 WWTP out of 24,577 m3/d of wastewater generated.  The indicator was introduced under the March 2020 restructuring??????? to better reflect project activities in Linshui. <em>Source: World Bank supervision reports</em></p>

title.narrative: PDO #2 Traveling time between Linshui town center and Linshui Economic Industrial Zone

comment.narrative: <p>Target EXCEEDED.  This indicator measures the travel time between Linshui town center and the Linshui ETDZ. ????The baseline reflects the travel time on Xinlin Avenue.  The result achieved on September 20, 2022 when construction of Number 1 Road was completed, and the traveling time was measured by dividing the distance of Number 1 Road by an average vehicle traveling speed of 40km/hr.  The indicator was introduced under the March 2020 restructuring, replacing an indicator which measured daily traffic on the road corridor.  <em>???????Source:  World Bank supervision reports</em></p>
